book.name: MAK
book.title: MAK Mak Iesu Keriso oisewa sen

content: Dion Iesu tauepi oisewa waiwandin
God Otua Iesu Keriso No Oise Kakaewa erewa mame.
Watageta God no oise waiwandini apanewa Aisaya oit mega ok manega sen, God anega wan,

content.text: Wapena anun, ne oit nega wapi apanewa,
namu watu enapen negin genan wareta.
Apan da pua, at kaimewa gapan,
opata ve anega waiwandin, ‘Ayop nuga negin mega wa tarasen,

content: Aisaya anenen wani tavewa venasen, ame apan Dion waenapan dup iamopen menan pua taue opata anega waiwandin, “E inak koewa taiana ae vean, imuya entanen ne dup iaepena amba God koewa ega anu ae veta.”
Waenapan aruga, at Diudia gapan amba pa Ierusalem nagire den Dion yao anupen men tauiwanumun. Koewa muga vetaet taiwanumun amba Dion kaum Diodan gapan dup iamuiwandin.
Dion wanup mega man kameru etua gume den eniwandin, amba berip mega, man etua paniwandin. Me taba mega naiwandini ame paki ge onaro.
Me opata gapan anega waiwandin, “Apan da evinap oniwandini me aiganap aroe amunu den taueta, amba ago otua ayop mega pusi okomewa vesini mini, ne ap wat agoaset anun, go ne kakae uon.
Ne kaum iragen gapan dup iaivin go me God Guewa Woup Seniwa gapan dup iaiwandata.”
Dion Iesu dup ien
Wam ame, Dion opata waiwandini ewap, Iesu at Galili pa Nasaret ae ve ae Dion ine tauen boge kaum Diodan gapan Dion yone Iesu dup ien.
Ame gine tutup, Iesu kaum ae ve kwatata ao dotoueni, amba kiman ase watapen, boge God Guewa Woup Seniwa nenip bairantan mini kimani visiwandin Iesu wapip doren.
Doriwandini amba nop da kimani anega tauen, “Ge ne otun iragenawa, imuna genan anu gurivin. Ge gamugap ne imuna ae meare tau aen.”
Seitan pusi warup Iesu inap taiwandin
Wani ewap, God Guewa Woup Seni Iesu nau at kaimewa aen.
Wam apane dere (40) pua wande eni gapan Seitan Iesu pusiwa warupe yaven. Anea tauan wat agoasene amba ap mepe man puawa den wanumune.
Iesu wadiamot mega erewa wa upamon
At Galili bawarewa nagirewa Dion waran gwat noke baraene ewap Iesu at Galili taue God Nop Oit Mega Kakaewa opata gapan wadidiam wandin.
Me anega wani, “God om enuni wamewa tauen, toemu mega amunewa tauapen taiwan. Koewa ega ae vean imuya entanen God Oit Mega Kakaewa anu tumasen.”
Iesu kaum awan Galili etop ap aiwandini, amba me Saimon, gwaniwa Anduru dere yawamon. Mu ia muga kauma antap eniwanumun, mu meo dawane taine nagirewa.
Iesu anega wadiamon, “Ewanap onaen, ne ta ewaepen e waenapan dawane tan.”
Boge ap gine tutup, mu ia muga ae vean amba me ewap amon.
Use sia aeni, apan Sebedi otu wai Diemis gwaniwa Dion dere yawamon. Mu kabum muga gwanap, ia muga nadi waran tata kakayat taiwanunum.
Boge Iesu venamu wan. Menan mamewa ago mega den kabum gagap ae vemon dere Iesu ewap amon.
Airampu apan potap wandeniwa
Iesu wadiamot mega den pa Kaponiam ame vit amon. Ian Diu pura muga bawarewa wamewa gapan Diu nagire opata waine paewa gwanap wadidiam wandin.
Me opata waiwandini gapan waenapan iragi no i kap wan, iwa me nop aroe amunu den waiwandin go iup wadidiamuine nagirewa nop muga amunu uon.
Airampu potap wandeni apanewa da taue ap mepe wanden amba Iesu opata waiwandini gapan

airampu senao uma anega wan, “Akae, ge Iesu pa Nasaret apanewa dim da inanup tat wa tauaan? Ge wa koeam nimanepen men tauan go? Ge orup ansena da ne asiginap di, ge God mega potaga Woup Seni apanewa.”
Iesu airampu ame anega dien, “Nop ae ve apan ae ve tau ak!”
Airampu apan ware enu menawase senao wa tau aen.
Waenapan ap yawanewa, iragi seke tan no i kap wan anega wawa mutane, “Ma anenen da taiwan? Nop ewakewa da? Nop mega aroe amunu den airampu up oimuiwandin tau amuiwanum.”
Iesu inak ame tani oit mega at Galili iragi senare tau aen.
Iesu waenapan aruga wat inakam mumiwandin
Iup anuine paewa ae veane amba Diemis ge Dion tanam apan Saimon ge Anduru pa muga amon.
Pa tauane Saimon tapunewa vek ato itanigaet ta eragi gagap iniwandini ame oisewa Iesu wadiane.
Menan Iesu me inap ae nanip ware ao endaveni gapan vek amun ame torot wan. Boge Pita tapunewa ao yone taba munen.
Amba mum gine taiwandiniwa, vek nagirewa amba airampu waramoni nagirewa aruga tambumon me inap tauane.
Ap menan pa nagirewa iragi tauan tonan barat mutan.
Vek ugup ugup iravi wat inakam mumen. Upi airampu potamup wanumone up oimon tau amon. Airampu Iesu ire yawan wapen tane go Iesu nop ae veapen menan yam ta yawamo wan.
Iesu at Galili gapan opata waiwandin
Mum igoe den, Iesu pa ae ve, God inap mup wapen menan waenapan uoni arewa aen. Ap mepe mup waiwandin.
Go Saimon evene wai den me yoa taiwanumune.
Amba Iesu yawane gapan, mu anega wane, “Waenapan iragi yoga taiwanum.”
Go Iesu gare wan, “Ne God toemu mega Oise Kakaewa at at iragi opata gapan wadidiamopen menan ongen. Ap tapen menan nu pa sewa da da den anet.”
Ap menan mu at Galili pa sewa tau ge tau amuiwanumune. Iesu Diu nagirewa iup anuine paewa gwanap opata waiwandin, den airampu upe oimuiwandin.
Iesu vek bo’o apanewa wat inakamen
Vek bo’o apanewa da Iesu ine taue namup omanip enu mup anega wan, “Ayop, gek anua gapan, tanege ne kakae tap.”
Iesu apan ame inap bagu sisi anuni menan naniwa endimase wapiwa inase anega wan, “Ne men anuivin, kakae ta!”
Gine tutup vek bo’o gamupewa siran taran amone me inakaen.

Wat inakameni menan nop kaimakaet anega wadien, “Endi inak mame inagap tana oisewa waenapan da ya wadiamo, noga botakamian. Amba tamana age pirisi ine taua vek gega uon tani yavep. Yavepi watageta apane Mosis vek mame inak warine gaunewa garaet God inap wanapen wani ame diagepi, ge di wan. Garaet ame wanawa, ap gapan waenapan yawage anuin, ame vek gega uon tan.” Amba Iesu apan ame wa oisen aen.

Go apan ame inak wareni oisewa at at iragi wadidiamon. Nop ame senareni menan Iesu pa sewa baware ame da aroga ase ya tauiwandin go at gine bigareni gapan ap mepe iwandin. Go ap mepe, waenapan at at iravi Iesu inap tauiwanumun.
